--- title: "Top Luxury Family Hotels Singapore — Marina Bay & Sentosa 2026"

description: "The best luxury family hotels in Singapore near Marina Bay and Sentosa — Marina Bay Sands, Fullerton Bay, Raffles Hotel, Capella Singapore, W Sentosa, and Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa — tested for family suites, connecting rooms, pools, and kid-friendly amenities." date: "2026-05-19" author: "Travel Asia with Kids" image: "/images/blog/top-luxury-family-hotels-singapore-marina-bay-2026.jpg" tags: [Singapore, luxury family hotels Singapore, Marina Bay, Sentosa, family suites, connecting rooms, kids clubs Singapore, Marina Bay Sands] category: "accommodation" --- ## Why Singapore is the Perfect Luxury Family Gateway Singapore is often called "Asia for beginners" — and for good reason. It's clean, safe, English-speaking, and has some of the best infrastructure for family travel anywhere in the world. But for luxury family travelers, Singapore offers something even more valuable: **world-class hotels that actually welcome children**. Unlike some destinations where kids are tolerated but not celebrated, Singapore's top hotels go out of their way to make families feel special. The city-state packs an extraordinary amount of family entertainment into a small area. Gardens by the Bay, Universal Studios Singapore, the SEA Aquarium (one of the world's largest), the Night Safari, and endless playgrounds are all within a 30-minute radius. The key is choosing a hotel that lets you access all of it without wasting precious vacation time on transit. ## What Makes a Great Luxury Family Hotel in Singapore? - **Family suites or connecting rooms** — Real space for four people, not a standard room with a rollaway bed - **Pool that kids actually enjoy** — A lap pool is useless to a 5-year-old. Look for shallow sections, splash zones, or waterslides. - **Proximity to MRT** — Singapore's public transport is excellent. Hotels with direct MRT access save taxi fares and time. - **Kids' programs** — Ideally free, with drop-off options so parents can enjoy alone time - **Dining flexibility** — Kids' menus, high chairs, and early dinner service - **Babysitting services** — Licensed and reliable ## 1. Marina Bay Sands **★★★★★ | Best for: The iconic infinity pool and non-stop family entertainment** Let's address the elephant in the room: yes, the **57th-floor infinity pool** is as spectacular as the photos suggest. But what many people don't know is that Marina Bay Sands is genuinely family-friendly. The hotel has dedicated family suites, a massive 1,500 sqm family pool on level 55 (separate from the famous infinity pool), and direct access to the Shoppes at Marina Bay — a mall with a canal you can ride in a sampan. The **Family Room (42 sqm / 452 sq ft)** features two queen beds and floor-to-ceiling views of the city skyline. **Family features:** - **Family pool** — Level 55 has a dedicated family pool with shallow areas (0.4m). The infinity pool (adults-only after 10 AM on weekends) allows children before 10 AM. - **Family rooms** — Two queen beds in a 42 sqm room. Connecting rooms available for larger families. - **Kids' activities** — Free guided tours of the ArtScience Museum (kid-friendly exhibits), SkyPark observation deck family hours, and the Digital Light Canvas experience. - **Proximity** — Directly connected to Bayfront MRT. 5-min walk to Gardens by the Bay. 10-min walk to Merlion Park. - **Dining** — Over 20 restaurants. Kids under 6 eat free at Rise Restaurant buffet. The food court at the Shoppes (Rasapura Masters) has budget-friendly options. - **Entertainment** — The Shoppes has an ice skating rink and canal boat ride. Spectra light-and-water show is free every evening. **💲 Family of 4: ~$400-800/night** (Family Room, including breakfast) **📍 Location:** Marina Bay, Bayfront MRT (direct connection) **📅 Best season:** February-April or July-September **Check prices for Marina Bay Sands on Booking.com** ## 2. The Fullerton Bay Hotel **★★★★★ | Best for: Heritage-meets-modern luxury on the water** The Fullerton Bay sits on the edge of Marina Bay with uninterrupted views of the skyline and the sea. This is a smaller, more intimate hotel (100 rooms) compared to the Sands, and the service is correspondingly more personal. The **Premier Harbour View rooms (38 sqm / 409 sq ft)** and **Bay View Suites (64 sqm / 689 sq ft)** offer floor-to-ceiling windows that make the skyline feel like it's in your room. Connecting rooms are available. **Family features:** - **Rooftop infinity pool** — 25m pool with stunning Marina Bay views. Shallow edge suitable for kids with supervision. - **Lantern Bar** — The bar's rooftop area is surprisingly kid-friendly during the afternoon. Kids get mocktails, parents get the view. - **Location** — Right on the Marina Bay waterfront. 5-min walk to Merlion Park, 10-min walk to Gardens by the Bay, 2-min walk to Raffles Place MRT. - **Dining** — Clifford Pier Restaurant has a legendary breakfast with local and Western options. Kids under 6 eat free. - **Babysitting** — Professional babysitters available through concierge. SGD 30/hour (~$22 USD). - **Heritage tour** — The Fullerton Building is a national monument. Complimentary heritage tour — kids find the history fascinating. **💲 Family of 4: ~$450-900/night** (two connecting Premier Harbour View rooms, including breakfast) **📍 Location:** Marina Bay, Raffles Place MRT (5-min walk) **📅 Best season:** Year-round **Check prices for Fullerton Bay Hotel on Booking.com** ## 3. Raffles Hotel Singapore **★★★★★ | Best for: Colonial grandeur and a one-of-a-kind family experience** After a $200 million restoration, the 115 suites at Raffles are among the most spacious in Singapore. The **Palm Court Suite (69 sqm / 743 sq ft)** sleeps a family of four comfortably, and the **Grand Hotel Suite (129 sqm / 1,388 sq ft)** with separate living and dining rooms is ideal for families. Every suite has a butler. **Family features:** - **Raffles Kids' Program** — Complimentary. Guided history tour, mocktail Singapore Sling-making class, chocolate-making workshop with the pastry chef. - **Pool** — 25m outdoor pool set in a tropical courtyard. Quiet, serene, and well-monitored. - **Butler service** — Your butler can unpack luggage, draw your bath, arrange babysitting, and set up a movie night in your suite. - **Location** — City Hall MRT is a 3-min walk. Raffles City shopping centre is connected. Esplanade and Fort Canning Park within walking distance. - **Dining** — Tiffin Room's high tea is a must with kids (they love the pastry selection). Kids under 12 eat free at select restaurants. - **Babysitting** — Available through butler service. All sitters are CPR-trained. **💲 Family of 4: ~$700-1,500/night** (Palm Court Suite, including breakfast and butler service) **📍 Location:** City Hall, City Hall MRT (3-min walk) **📅 Best season:** Year-round **Check prices for Raffles Hotel on Booking.com** ## 4. Capella Singapore **★★★★★ | Best for: Resort-style luxury on Sentosa Island** Capella Singapore is a **tropical resort on Sentosa Island** set on 30 acres of rainforest. The colonial-meets-contemporary buildings house some of the largest rooms in Singapore. The **One-Bedroom Garden Villa (105 sqm / 1,130 sq ft)** has a private plunge pool, while two-bedroom villas (up to 250 sqm / 2,690 sq ft) are perfect for families. **Family features:** - **Capella Kids' Club** — Ages 4-12. Complimentary. Nature walks, Batik painting, cupcake decorating, origami. Open 9 AM-5 PM. - **Three pools** — Main 25m lap pool, family pool with shallow section, and dedicated kids' wading pool. Family pool is heated. - **Beach access** — Palawan Beach is a 5-min walk (or free shuttle). Calm waters, soft sand. - **Sentosa proximity** — Universal Studios Singapore is a 10-min drive. SEA Aquarium, Adventure Cove Waterpark minutes away. - **Dining** — The Knolls has a fantastic breakfast buffet with a kids' corner. Cassia serves modern Cantonese with a kids' dim sum set. - **Babysitting** — SGD 35/hour. Professional nannies with early childhood education backgrounds. **💲 Family of 4: ~$600-1,400/night** (one-bedroom garden villa, including breakfast) **📍 Location:** Sentosa Island, free shuttle to HarbourFront MRT **📅 Best season:** Year-round **Check prices for Capella Singapore on Booking.com** ## 5. W Singapore — Sentosa Cove **★★★★ | Best for: Trendy family luxury with a splash of fun** The W Singapore on Sentosa is bold, colourful, and unapologetically cool — but it works surprisingly well for families. The **Spectacular Suite (83 sqm / 893 sq ft)** with separate living room and the **E-WOW Suite (150 sqm / 1,615 sq ft)** with a private terrace are spacious enough for families. **Family features:** - **WET Pool** — Main pool with shallow kids' section and pool toys provided. One of the most fun pool environments on Sentosa. - **Kids' welcome** — W-branded backpack with stickers, coloring book, and a small toy on arrival. - **Sentral Kids' Club** — Ages 4-12. Free. Foosball, video games, arts and crafts, movie screenings. - **Location** — Sentosa Cove within walking distance of Quayside Isle (family-friendly restaurants). Free shuttle to Universal Studios and VivoCity Mall. - **Dining** — SKIRT restaurant has an excellent kids' menu. Sunday brunch includes a kids' corner with face painting. **💲 Family of 4: ~$400-800/night** (Spectacular Suite, including breakfast) **📍 Location:** Sentosa Cove, free shuttle to HarbourFront MRT **📅 Best season:** Year-round **Check prices for W Singapore Sentosa on Booking.com** ## 6. Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa **★★★★★ | Best for: Beachfront resort with the best family pool in Singapore** The Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa is Singapore's only beachfront resort, sitting directly on Siloso Beach. While it's not as ultra-luxurious as Capella or Raffles, it's the **best resort in Singapore for families who want easy beach access**. The **Family Sea View Room (38 sqm / 409 sq ft)** or a connecting room setup works well. The **Siloso Wing** is specifically designed for families. **Family features:** - **Three pools** — Free-form outdoor pool with a 70m waterslide, an adventure pool with splash zone and water cannons, and a separate kids' wading pool. The waterslide is the best in any Singapore hotel. - **Cool Zone Kids' Club** — Ages 4-12. Free. Themed around a "cool zone" concept with art stations, video games, a reading nook, and daily supervised activities. - **Beach access** — Direct access to Siloso Beach. Complimentary beach toys, kayaks, and body boards. - **Dining** — Kids under 6 eat free. The Barn Bar has a family-friendly barbecue dinner by the beach. - **Babysitting** — SGD 28/hour. Licensed and reliable. - **Location** — Free shuttle to HarbourFront MRT. 15-min walk to Universal Studios. **💲 Family of 4: ~$350-700/night** (Family Sea View Room, including breakfast) — **Best value beachfront luxury** **📍 Location:** Siloso Beach, Sentosa Island **📅 Best season:** Year-round **Check prices for Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa on Booking.com** ## Connecting Rooms vs. Family Suites: What's Best in Singapore? Singapore hotels can charge a premium for two rooms, so here's how to maximize value: - **True family suites** — Marina Bay Sands Family Rooms and Capella Garden Villas are genuine single-room configurations for 4 people - **Connecting rooms** — Fullerton Bay and Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa offer reliable connecting rooms. Always confirm at booking. - **Two-bedroom villas** — Capella Singapore offers the best two-bedroom villa configuration on this list at a reasonable premium - **Suite with sofa bed** — W Singapore's Spectacular Suite has a pull-out sofa that's comfortable for kids under 12 ## The Verdict For first-time family visitors to Singapore, **Marina Bay Sands** is the obvious choice — the location is unbeatable, the room configurations work for families, and the kids will never forget the infinity pool. For a quieter, more luxurious experience, **Capella Singapore** on Sentosa offers resort-style living with excellent kids' facilities. For the best beach-and-pool combination, **Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa** delivers the best value with its waterslide and direct beach access. **Our Booking Recommendation:** Singapore hotels rarely offer the same cancellation flexibility as Booking.com. Book through a platform with free cancellation — family plans change, and Singapore is expensive enough without paying for a room you can't use. *Last updated: May 2026. Prices are estimates for a family of four (two adults + two children under 12) during low season. Always verify kids' club availability and connecting room configurations at the time of booking.* ## FAQ ### Which Singapore hotel has the best pool for kids? **Marina Bay Sands** has two pools — the famous infinity pool (allowed before 10 AM with kids) and a dedicated family pool on level 55. **Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa** has a 70m waterslide that kids absolutely love. ### What is the best area in Singapore for families? **Marina Bay** (Marina Bay Sands, Fullerton Bay) is closest to Gardens by the Bay, the Merlion, and the CBD. **Sentosa** (Capella, W Sentosa, Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa) is closer to Universal Studios, beaches, and has more relaxed pacing. ### Does Raffles Hotel allow children? Yes — Raffles genuinely welcomes children. They have a dedicated kids' program with mocktail-making and chocolate workshops. That said, the atmosphere is quieter and more formal than other options — better for older kids (6+) who can appreciate the history. ### Which Singapore hotel has connecting rooms? **The Fullerton Bay Hotel**, **Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa**, and **Marina Bay Sands** all offer reliable connecting room configurations. Always confirm at the time of booking. ### What is the cheapest time to book luxury Singapore hotels? **January-February** (post-holiday lull) and **September** (school term week) offer the lowest rates. Avoid December and June-July (peak school holidays) when rates can double. ### Do Singapore luxury hotels offer halal options? Yes — all hotels on this list accommodate halal dietary requirements with advance notice. Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa and Raffles Hotel are particularly well-equipped for halal dining requests.
